module.capability: Search attributable public building records, inspect licensed reference image pages, and record bounded evidence gaps.
input_contract: Current request.json, revised discovery-plan.json, and sources.json.
Allow-listed public sources and hash-bound local project artifacts.
output_contract: Append-only attempt JSON with source IDs, precise locators, per-gap outcomes and stop reason.
evidence_contract: Non-unknown claims cite a registered source and page section, image-page metadata, or observed frame.
Retrieval failures, license constraints, scope conflicts and unknowns remain explicit.
allowed_actions: Search public official, primary-reporting, and open-media records.
Open source pages and visually inspect indexed reference images in browser.
Update source register and append this attempt/index.
forbidden_actions: Treat search-result indexing as direct page access.
Copy source photos into production assets or republish them without satisfying license/permission.
Modify or replace the delivered video.
Call external model providers or reveal credentials.
side_effects: Updated this job source register, discovery plan, append-only attempt/index and machine-readable current status only.
module.data_retention: Local research record. External media remains linked only; original source files are not copied into app assets.

lifecycle.upgrade: Create a new module version and a new attempt.
lifecycle.rollback: Select an earlier indexed attempt without deleting this record.
lifecycle.replacement: Register a replacement module identity and rerun against current bindings.
lifecycle.revocation: Stop selecting this module and mark subsequent attempts NOT_RUN.

limitations: No original reconstruction drawings or dimensioned elevations were located.
Yuncheng government page direct retrieval timed out; its indexed page body is attributed as search-indexed text.
The two visually inspected Commons photographs show front views only; no rear or true side elevation was found.
No quantitative photographic measurement or measured architectural accuracy is claimed.
Exact-phrase follow-up returned unrelated construction documents; they were excluded rather than imported as Guanque evidence.

queries.query: site:yuncheng.gov.cn/doc/2020/07/21/71073.shtml 鹳雀楼 57.4 73.9 83 72 五间 三间 钢筋水泥骨架
queries.result: Search index returned the indexed page body with dimensions, qualitative form and skeleton material. Direct page fetch timed out; recorded as indexed text, not direct access.

queries.query: 鹳雀楼 更上层楼 台基三层 楼身六层 设计图纸
queries.result: Opened People Daily article directly. It reports platform 3 levels/body 6 levels, total 73.9 m, current rebuild in 2002, and says historical reconstruction documents were not found although new design drawings were produced.

queries.query: Wikimedia Commons Stork Tower Guanque Tower photographs
queries.result: Commons category lists five media files. Two current-building photographs were opened, license pages checked, and images visually inspected; both are front views, not additional side/rear coverage.
File page identifies author/source, date, 1680x1260 dimensions and CC BY 2.5; displayed image is a distant centered front view.

queries.query: Inspect Commons File:鹳雀楼.jpg and cropped derivative
queries.result: File page identifies author, capture date, location metadata and CC BY-SA 4.0; displayed image is a closer near-frontal view showing stair, podium and stacked exterior levels.

queries.query: Search for public reconstruction elevations and dimensioned details
queries.result: No public dimensioned elevation or structural drawing located. People Daily describes the reconstruction design archives as extensive but does not publish them; 16.5 m platform height and lower 7x5 grid remain unverified.

queries.query: Search for a published structural system description or wall layout
queries.result: Government indexed text supports a reinforced-concrete skeleton but no frame-shear-wall subtype or wall locations; no structural drawing located.

queries.query: Inventory registered user reference coverage against the current-source package
queries.result: User references remain two front-oblique images; no rear/side views, interior plans or concealed-structure drawings are registered.

queries.query: Compare pinned upstream and prior pilot assembly progression
queries.result: R1 media hashes remain unchanged; its sampled comparison is retained: demo grows from the base while pilot opens complete, disassembles, then rebuilds. No full cadence audit performed.

queries.query: 鹳雀楼 台基高16.5米 7间 5间 37.8 25.8 原文
queries.result: Targeted search returned no attributable Guanque source stating the 16.5 m platform vertical height or lower 7 x 5 bay grid. The only relevant government result repeated 57.4 m main and 73.9 m total; unrelated pages were excluded.

queries.query: 鹳雀楼 框架 剪力墙 施工组织设计 PDF
queries.result: Search returned generic frame/shear-wall construction documents for other buildings, not the Guanque reconstruction. No Guanque-specific structural drawing or frame-shear-wall source located.

queries.query: 鹳雀楼 92根 柱 斗拱 2万 施工 图纸
queries.result: No source-backed Guanque drawing or attributable detail count located; unrelated architectural material was excluded.

observations.statement: Yuncheng Government indexed page body reports main-building height 57.4 m, total height 73.9 m, and rectangular platform footprint 83 x 72 m (310 m perimeter).
observations.locator: Search-indexed page body, “主楼” section; direct open timed out.

observations.statement: The same indexed page reports top floor as five bays wide by three bays deep, exterior appearance as three storeys/four eaves, with six interior levels.
observations.locator: Search-indexed page body, “主楼” section and following interior-level description; direct open timed out.

observations.statement: People Daily reports three levels in the platform and six levels in the tower body, total height 73.9 m; this supports a 3+6 platform/body count, not nine interior floors.
observations.locator: 2025-04-09 article, paragraphs beginning “登鹳雀楼看什么” and “现存鹳雀楼于2002年复建”.

observations.statement: No directly inspected source found the user-reported 16.5 m platform vertical height or lower 7 x 5 bay grid. Do not derive platform height by subtracting 57.4 from 73.9 because datum definitions are not supplied.
observations.locator: Compared indexed government “主楼” section, directly opened People Daily article, and docs/user-reference.md.

observations.statement: People Daily reports that no related reconstruction documents were found in historical materials and local gazetteers; the reconstruction team generated extensive design drawings, but the report does not publish the drawings.
observations.locator: 2025-04-09 article, paragraph beginning “于元初毁于战火以后”; paragraph states design drawings filled multiple trucks.

observations.statement: Yuncheng Government indexed text describes four eaves, four projecting Xieshan-style baosha, surrounding corridors and round columns, partition doors, curved eaves, glazed ridge tiles, paired chiwen and a central finial; it does not give measured joint/bracket geometry.
observations.locator: Search-indexed page body, “主楼” section; exact bracket details absent; direct page open timed out.

observations.statement: The Wikimedia Commons file is labeled as a front view dated 2017-10-06; the displayed image shows the current rebuilt tower and front plaza from a distant, nearly centered viewpoint.
observations.locator: Commons file page Summary plus browser visual inspection of the image; file page lists 1680 x 1260 and CC BY 2.5.

observations.statement: The Wikimedia Commons 2020 image shows a near-frontal plaza view with the stair, podium face and stacked exterior levels; it is a cropped extraction from a larger photograph, not a side/rear view.
observations.locator: Commons file page image and Summary/metadata; original captured 2020-09-17, CC BY-SA 4.0; browser visual inspection.

observations.statement: People Daily reports the extant Guanque Tower was rebuilt and opened in 2002; the current visitor building is not the surviving Tang-era original.
observations.locator: 2025-04-09 article, paragraphs beginning “2002年” and “现存鹳雀楼于2002年复建”.

observations.statement: The inspected public photographs add two front views but no verified rear or orthographic side elevation; the current package still lacks those views.
observations.locator: Two Commons file pages and visible images plus jobs/guanque-pilot/sources.json view inventory.

observations.statement: Public text and front photographs support broad silhouette and named features, but exact bracket-set geometry, roof intersections, rear facade openings and dimensioned details remain unsupported.
observations.locator: Compared indexed government text, two Commons front images, People Daily reconstruction report, and docs/photo-comparison-r3.md.

observations.statement: R1 sampled-video observation remains bound to the unchanged upstream demo and prior pilot hashes: the demo builds from the base, while the pilot opens complete, disassembles and rebuilds.
observations.locator: R1 attempt demo-growth-sequence and pilot-reverse-then-forward observations; r2 did not alter either video.

observations.statement: Yuncheng Government indexed page describes a steel-reinforced cement/concrete skeleton; it supports a concrete skeleton at high level but not the user-reported frame-shear-wall subtype or wall locations.
observations.locator: Search-indexed page body, “主楼” final sentence; direct open timed out.

observations.statement: No structural drawings, frame schedule or shear-wall layout was found in this bounded search; do not visualize hidden load paths as verified.
observations.locator: People Daily reconstruction-report search and open; Yuncheng indexed page; bounded query log.

observations.statement: Registered user references and newly inspected Commons images are all front-facing exteriors; no rear/side elevations, interior plans or concealed-structure drawings were observed.
observations.locator: sources.json views plus Commons 2017 and 2020 images.

outcomes.summary: Official indexed text and directly opened People Daily reporting now corroborate 73.9 m total height, 57.4 m main height, 83 x 72 m platform footprint, 3-level platform + 6-level body, and top 5 x 3 bay count. The phrase “nine interior levels” was corrected: evidence supports a 3+6 platform/body count, while the official indexed source separately describes six interior levels. No explicit source for 16.5 m platform vertical height or lower 7 x 5 grid was found.
limitations: Government page direct fetch timed out; facts are attributed to its indexed page body.
Do not derive platform vertical height by subtraction.
Floor-counting terminology differs by source; preserve platform/body/interior labels.

outcomes.summary: Current 2002 rebuilt-building identity is supported by People Daily, and two openly licensed front-view photographs supplement the reference package. All observed photographs remain front views; side, rear and orthographic elevations are still missing.
limitations: Commons photos are research references; any reuse must satisfy CC BY 2.5 or CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution terms.

outcomes.summary: Official indexed description and inspected front photographs support the broad four-eave, three-exterior-storey silhouette, projecting baosha, corridors, columns, partition facade and top 5 x 3 bays. Exact bracket sets, roof intersections and hidden facade details still lack dimensioned drawings or close detail evidence.
limitations: The cited government source was indexed but timed out on direct open.
The front images are not close bracket-detail photographs.
R3 pixel ratios remain visual notes, not surveyed geometry.

outcomes.summary: R1 source-hash-bound video comparison still confirms the central assembly narrative mismatch. Component-by-component travel, pacing, materials and lighting remain to be mapped against the complete demo.
limitations: R2 did not re-sample the videos; this retains R1 observations only.

outcomes.summary: The official indexed source supports a reinforced-concrete/cement skeleton at a high level. It does not identify a frame-shear-wall subtype or publish shear-wall placement; no structural drawings were located.
limitations: Direct government page open timed out.
No structural simulation or load-path claim.

outcomes.summary: The two new public images are frontal only, alongside two front-oblique user views. Rear and side facades, room plans and concealed structure remain unobserved.
limitations: Do not mirror front details to invent unseen facades.

stop_reason: The r2 search budget included targeted exact-phrase follow-up for missing platform height, lower bay grid, bracket count and frame-shear-wall subtype. No attributable Guanque-specific original was located. The open gaps remain recorded without invented resolution, media republication or new acceptance.
